title: Data center opposition surged from 42 to 75 percent in just one year, survey finds
summary: Three out of four Americans now oppose having a data center built near them, up from an even split just a year ago, according to a Heatmap News survey. 61 percent are "strongly opposed." The article Data center opposition surged from 42 to 75 percent in just one year, survey finds appeared first on The Decoder .
